tasks.title: Session child cleanup
tasks.description: Unregister closed Present windows from the deck session graph and exclude them from directed sends so the UI and program state stay consistent.

tasks.title: End blank program state
tasks.description: Route End through the main-owned deck session so it sends a directed blank payload to the selected Present children and clears the presenter viewport state. Ensure Deck state becomes blank and Start after End sends the first slide again.

tasks.title: Program thumbnail fidelity
tasks.description: Make the on-program preview derive from the same program state sent to Present, including messages, song lyric segments, green-screen behavior, and blank output after End. Move the preview into the Presentation controls region and verify updates for every navigation and send action.

tasks.title: Theme persistence relaunch
tasks.description: Replace browser-only theme persistence with a durable user-owned preference store that is independent of the application working directory, while preserving live synchronization across Home, deck, and Present windows. Restore valid themes before first paint where possible and safely fall back for missing or invalid values.

tasks.title: Durable library storage
tasks.description: Move the default SQLite and JSON library roots to ~/.poster, add one-time migration from cwd poster.sqlite or poster.library.json, and provide settings to re-point the library without moving or deleting the old directory. Preserve library data across application updates, cwd changes, and reinstall simulations.

tasks.title: Home regression guard
tasks.description: Add a regression check that Home does not expose a bare Open Present action and that the deck remains the only route that creates session-scoped Present windows. Keep the existing Home library and Open Presentation behavior covered.

tasks.title: Test harness and CI
tasks.description: Add the required unit, integration, and Playwright smoke coverage for End blanking, thumbnail fidelity and placement, theme relaunch, Present close cleanup, durable library migration and re-pointing, and the Home guard. Wire stable unit and integration suites into PR CI and document isolated Electron relaunch coverage where applicable.

tasks.title: Acceptance documentation sync
tasks.description: Update README.md, ralph/epic.md, the applicable epic plan, and requirements.md to describe the shipped durable preferences, ~/.poster library behavior, migration, re-pointing, and Present regression fixes. Keep operator commands and acceptance status consistent with the implementation.
